anya (tp): spotting an odd perf regression on TP+flash-attn when serving streams with KV sharding. latency + tail up 2-3x for some tokens.

sam (runtime): repro? sequence length and TP config?

anya (tp): tp=4, model=rw-large-16k, seqs batched variable [64, 320, 1024], kv_shard=true. Happens when prefix len not divisible by 32 and when flash-attn path chosen. root cause looks like repeated QKV all-gather + small all-reduces between microbatches.

rui (profiler): attaching flame snippet: "allgather_qkv: 210ms, local_attn: 30ms, nccl_stall: 120ms". Also saw NCCL stalls at step boundary. Profiling cmd I used:

``
./profiler --model rw-large-16k --tp 4 --seq 1024 --kv-shard --sample 200
``

perf-bot: Performance alert: 2026-03-17T16:22Z - +150% p99 latency on rw-large-16k in Dedicated pool eu-west.

frank (serving): hypothesis: kernel selector is picking flash-attn fused QKV that expects a contiguous KV layout; when kv cache is sharded we insert allgather/reshard steps that break vectorization and cause many tiny all-reduces. fallback kernel should be non-fused qkv that avoids extra allgathers.

sam (runtime): agreed. current heuristic: prefer flash if seq_len>512 and batch>4. Needs to consider kv_shard and seq_stride. I can add a quick guard: require kv_shard=false to use flash-attn. That should cut off the regression.

anya (tp): also seeing batching heuristic produce tiny microbatches because of latency SLOs; those cause repeated small allgathers — maybe group microbatches at the TP boundary. Could add a coalescing window ~20ms to accumulate tokens before triggering an all-gather.

rui (profiler): quick experiment numbers: baseline (no flash): p50 110ms p99 350ms. with flash+kv_shard: p50 125ms p99 680ms. flash disabled: p50 115ms p99 360ms. So flash with kv_shard is worse.

sam (runtime): plan: 1) emergency guard in kernel selector to avoid flash if kv_shard=true; 2) tweak batching coalescer to prefer grouping variable-length sequences to reduce small-allgathers; 3) open perf regression ticket and run nightly benchmark.

anya (tp): thanks. cc frank (serving) and rui (profiler). i'll add a repro harness and sequence generator (variable prefix lengths to hit the edge).

sam (runtime): filing: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RWI-4521 (WIP). will roll a hotfix to runtime kernel selector behind flag `--no-flash-kvshard`.

frank (serving): minor note: we should document the tradeoff in release notes and Redwood Optimize recommendations (quantization/batching suggestions).

anya (tp): :thumbsup:
